template/project/AGENTS.md.name: Project instructions template

template/project/CLAUDE.md.description: Makes Claude Code read the project's shared instructions file so no second copy is needed.

template/user/AGENTS.md.name: Personal instructions template
template/user/AGENTS.md.description: Provides a starting file for your own preferences, shared by Codex, Claude Code and Cursor across all your projects.

template/user/memory/MEMORY.md.name: Memory index
template/user/memory/MEMORY.md.description: Provides the starting list of saved memory notes, one line per note, that the AI assistants read at the start of a session.
